new_learnings.text: A hot lead sector is not enough when breadth fails the minimum gate; today's semiconductor strength coexists with only 1.17:1 breadth and 55跌停, so the correct momentum action is still zero new positions.
new_learnings.mechanism: Narrow leadership without broad confirmation creates poor follow-through and high gap-risk for fresh entries.

new_learnings.text: The MA-distance anti-chase rule removes many of the most tempting names today, especially PCB and electronic-material stocks that already sit too far above MA5/MA10.
new_learnings.mechanism: When leaders get extended away from short-term support, reward/risk deteriorates even if the narrative remains strong.

new_learnings.text: Among today's candidate set, the best 'next-up when regime improves' profiles are the stocks that pass both RPS and MA-distance gates, such as 华峰测控、深科达、北化股份.
new_learnings.mechanism: When regime is weak, preserving a ready list of technically compliant leaders is more valuable than forcing low-quality entries.

market_summary: Breadth 1.17:1 weak-to-fragile, only 上证指数 green while 深成指/创业板指 are red, and 98涨停/55跌停 keeps the tape in panic-block territory by system rules. Sector leadership is clear in 半导体 and 科创 related names, with research also pointing to chip strength and 覆铜板涨价 as catalysts, but participation is not broad enough to authorize fresh longs. IV context is unavailable, so no stock-specific throttle can offset the hard regime block. Keep cash, stalk compliant leaders, and wait for breadth >=1.5:1 plus at least 2 major indices green.
